claim: Is Working at Walmart worth it? : r/walmart - Reddit
summary: Hi everyone I am looking for a new job because my current employer only pays me $9.50 an hour for doing the job for 3 people and I noticed that Walmart is hiring for $14 an hour for a few different positions, so I wanted to know if working at Walmart is worth it, and how many interviews I would need to pass to get the job.
